title: Viking orbiter image of the Face on Mars

tellings.quote: the mid 1970s the Viking orbiters sent back an image that caused quite a stir a mile long structure that resembled a human face

plain: In the mid 1970s NASA's Viking orbiters, spacecraft circling Mars, sent back an image of a mile-long structure in the Cydonia region that looked like a human face, and it caused quite a stir. Michels tells this himself in introducing an episode about life on Mars, as a hint that something built may once have stood there.
